# AgentScope misbehaving across model integrations, middleware, permissions and storage backends — without a test suite

Agents built with this library ask hosted and on-machine language vendors for answers, have those answers read aloud, reach for abilities that live outside the process, ask a person before doing anything risky, carry knowledge between conversations, hand work off to isolated environments elsewhere, and search over documents. All of that is now wrong in one place or another. The repository has received 20 separate undocumented edits. The observations below were gathered by hand while exercising unrelated things; each observation stands on its own, and repairing one does nothing for the others.

Getting an answer out of one widely used hosted vendor fails outright as soon as the conversation handed over has a single turn in it — plain assistant text, thinking carried across as reasoning, an inline picture sent as encoded bytes, guidance both text-only and with pictures, requested calls interleaved with their results, pictures returned inside those results, and the multi-party arrangement all fail — while an empty conversation still yields an empty result. Replies from that same vendor also come back wrong, both when delivered whole (plain text, reasoning then text, a request to run something) and when delivered incrementally (text pieces, reasoning pieces then text, pieces of a request accumulating into a final answer).
